variants.name: simulation
variants.description: Population projection for one country where users set the fertility, life expectancy and migration assumptions

variants.name: population
variants.description: Line chart of one country's population over time, by default the UN projection

variants.name: populationPyramid
variants.description: Age and sex pyramid of one country's population

variants.name: parameters
variants.description: Line charts of the fertility, life expectancy and migration assumptions behind one country's population projection

config.name: title
config.description: Chart title, replacing the generated one

config.name: subtitle
config.description: Chart subtitle, replacing the generated one

config.name: region
config.description: Country shown first, or United States if the data doesn't have it. `userLocation` picks the user's country

config.name: time
config.description: Year shown first. `populationPyramid` only

config.name: fertilityRateAssumptions
config.format: Up to three comma-separated numbers for 2030, 2050 and 2100, such as `1.8,,1.5`. An empty entry keeps the UN projection
config.description: Fertility rate assumptions, in births per woman

config.name: lifeExpectancyAssumptions
config.format: Up to three comma-separated numbers for 2030, 2050 and 2100, such as `80,,85`. An empty entry keeps the UN projection
config.description: Life expectancy assumptions, in years

config.name: netMigrationRateAssumptions
config.format: Up to three comma-separated numbers for 2030, 2050 and 2100, such as `2,,1`. An empty entry keeps the UN projection
config.description: Net migration rate assumptions, per 1,000 people. The chart shows them as a percentage

config.name: focusParameter
config.description: Assumption shown first in the editor. `simulation` only

config.name: populationPyramidUnit
config.description: Show the pyramid as shares or as numbers of people. `simulation` and `populationPyramid` only

config.name: hideEntitySelector
config.description: Show the country as plain text instead of a selector

config.name: hidePopulationPyramid
config.description: Hide the population pyramid. `simulation` only

config.name: hideTimeline
config.description: Hide the year slider and fit the axis to the year shown. `populationPyramid` only

config.name: showAssumptionCharts
config.description: Add a collapsible section with the assumption charts. `population` and `populationPyramid` only

variants.name: sankey
variants.description: Sankey of which countries trade one food product with each other

config.name: title
config.description: Chart title, replacing the generated one. Also hides the heading and controls

config.name: subtitle
config.description: Chart subtitle, replacing the generated one. Also hides the heading and controls

config.name: product
config.description: Food product shown first

config.name: country
config.description: Country shown first, or All countries if the data doesn't have it. `userLocation` picks the user's country

config.name: flow
config.description: Trade direction shown first. Ignored when the country is All countries

config.name: hideControls

config.name: hideFlowSwitcher
config.description: Hide the switch between imports, exports and both

prose.notes:
- `povertyLine` is always in international-$ per day, whatever `currency` and `timeInterval` say; the chart converts it.
- Countries in `countries` that the data doesn't have are left out silently. `userLocation` is left out when the user's country can't be detected.
- A custom `title` or `subtitle` hides the controls, as `hideControls` does.

variants.name: distribution
variants.description: Income mountains: how the world's population, or selected countries', is spread across income levels

config.name: title
config.description: Chart title, replacing the generated one. Also hides the controls

config.name: subtitle
config.description: Chart subtitle, replacing the generated one. Also hides the controls

config.name: view
config.description: View shown first: `global` stacks every country by World Bank region, `countries` draws the selected countries side by side

config.name: countries
config.format: Comma-separated country names, such as `China, India, userLocation`
config.description: Countries of the selected-countries view. `userLocation` adds the user's country. Defaults to China, the United States, India, Nigeria and the user's country

config.name: year
config.description: Year shown, from 1990 to 2026. The chart has no year control. From 2025 on, the figures are World Bank nowcasts

config.name: povertyLine
config.description: Poverty line drawn first, in international-$ per day. If unset, the user can draw one by clicking the chart

config.name: timeInterval
config.description: Whether incomes are shown per day, month or year

config.name: currency
config.description: Three-letter code of the country whose currency incomes are shown in, such as `DEU`. `userLocation` picks the user's currency. Defaults to international-$

config.name: hideControls
config.description: Hide the view, countries, time interval and currency controls, and the button that clears the poverty line
